_source: Manually curated from https://untappd.com/blog's 'New Badge: X' posts - these are Untappd's own time-limited promotional badges, never in the permanent badges.untappd.com catalog (badge_beer_categories.json/badge_venue_categories.json), so they have to be read and re-catalogued by hand whenever a new one is announced. Checked live 2026-11-16 - entries are ACTIVE-or-UPCOMING as of that date (activeUntil >= today). The previously-catalogued 'Untappd Check-In Challenge: Week 2' badge was pruned this check since its activeUntil (2026-11-15) has now passed, leaving this list empty. Week 3 (Nov 16-22) of the ongoing Season 1 series (flagged in special_badges_pending_review.json) starts today but its specific criteria text is not yet published on either the season-overview post or a dedicated weekly post - re-check for it on a later pass, same way Week 2's own post later revealed its criteria. No other new 'New Badge' posts were found since the prior check (Bar Fly, Amaro Day, Champagne Day, Mezcal Day, Gin & Tonic Day, Scream-Worthy Hard Cider, Liqueur Day, Pumpkin Beer Season, Barrel-Aged Beer Day, Untappd 16th Anniversary, International Stout Day are all already-handled posts from earlier checks - either previously added-then-expired-and-pruned, flagged pending review, or found already-moot). New posts whose criteria this schema can't compute (brewery-specific, venue-location, or otherwise ambiguous) are logged in special_badges_pending_review.json instead of guessed here. Re-check the blog periodically (no feed/API for this - it's a real page read each time) and prune entries whose activeUntil has passed, same way this list was built.
